title: Fire-retardant-treated wood.
officialText:
Fire-retardant-treated wood is any wood product which, when impregnated
with chemicals by a pressure process or other means during manufacture, shall have, when tested in accordance with
ASTM E 84 or UL 723, a listed flame spread index of 25 or less and show no evidence of significant progressive combustion
when the test is continued for an additional 20-minute period. Additionally, the flame front shall not progress more than
101/2 feet (3200 mm) beyond the centerline of the burners at any time during the test.
